sources.source_crs: Service EPSG:3857; checked-in feature snapshot stored in WGS84/EPSG:4326
sources.geometry_use: The first exterior ring of feature 912 controls the shell; all 24 ring vertices are preserved without rescaling. The polygon surface is about 1112.12 m2 after local geographic conversion. The GIS service Shape__Area is a separate cartographic attribute and was not substituted for the ring area.

sources.provider: Purdue University Bechtel Innovation Design Center
sources.supports: Facility use and published first-floor, second-floor, and basement plans; no elevations or surveyed dimensions used.
Facility purpose, student use, and BIDC-specific photographs.

Project size above 32,000 square feet, opened summer 2017, high-bay flexible area, fabrication/prototyping labs, assembly/storage and vehicle lab, exterior plaza, natural light and transparent environment.

building_specific_photo.observed: Prominent two-storey glazed frontage with fine metal mullions, broad light gray opaque panel cladding, low-profile roof edge, and visible makerspace interior. Used to guide finish and glazing emphasis; photo perspective and unmeasured locations are not treated as dimensions.

geometry.coordinate_frame: Local metres, X east, Y north, Z up; centered at official GIS polygon centroid.
geometry.height_status: Estimated visualization value; no verified elevation or section drawing located. GIS Elevation is 0; legacy Extrution value is not treated as building height.
geometry.envelope: Footprint-driven low-slope shell with light gray panel finish, glazing across all sufficiently long ring walls, a two-storey entrance glazing cue, metal mullions, floor bands, parapet and schematic rooftop plant.
geometry.interior: Only a small workshop vignette behind glazing. Schematic use cues, not a floor-plan model or as-built room layout.
geometry.facade_status: Specific front-of-building glazing and light cladding are supported by the architect photo; bay spacing, floor heights, roof plant, other facade sides and opening extents are estimated.

uncertainties: The source GIS cartographic area attribute differs from the projected surface area of the feature ring; the ring geometry was retained as the authoritative plan outline.
GIS level count and extrusion attributes conflict with the publicly posted floor-plan set and are not reliable vertical measurements.
Two visible above-ground stories are inferred from the building-specific project photo and available plans; roof height is estimated at 10.8 m.
No as-built elevations, verified roof plan, or measured facade dimensions were found. Architectural details away from the photographed frontage are interpretive.
The few interior objects are schematic evidence of makerspace use only; they do not recreate a specific plan or equipment schedule.

candidate_grade.builder_self_assessment: The missing detailed library is reconstructed and contract-validated; the GIS outline, source-backed facade direction, dedicated module, evidence archive, and reopen previews are complete. Height and unphotographed details remain estimated.
